简介: Victoria grew up in Michigan pursuing acting and music from an early age. After graduating from Western Michigan University's acting program, she got her start in the Chicago theatre scene at Steppenwolf Theatre, quickly landing onscreen roles as well. Victoria is featured in WandaVision for Marvel. Also a singer/songwriter, Victoria released her debut solo album 'Lo-fi Love Songs' in 2019 on indie record label Already Dead Tapes & Records.
